name: fetch
when_to_use: When the agent must read a live URL the filesystem cannot reach

name: filesystem
when_to_use: When scoped file read/write is needed inside the project

name: github
when_to_use: When working with repos, issues, pull requests or releases

name: memory
when_to_use: When facts must persist across sessions as a knowledge graph

name: openrouter
when_to_use: When a $0.00 model matrix transport is needed for a subagent; it is a remote-over-HTTPS MCP endpoint, not an installable npm package

name: sequential-thinking
when_to_use: When a problem needs structured step-by-step reasoning

name: context7
when_to_use: When up-to-date library or framework docs are needed before using an API

name: firecrawl
when_to_use: When a page must be deeply scraped or extracted rather than merely fetched
